Faraday

Agentic AI that stays within Western

Tyler Browne · Mike Hallett

Department of Biochemistry · Schulich School of Medicine & Dentistry · Western University

Thursday 26 November 2026 · Schulich Research Data Management & IT Infrastructure Needs

Why “Faraday”?

  • Faraday cage: metal mesh, signals kept out
  • Inside: safe from the lightning
  • Faraday: agentic AI behind one watched door

Chat answers. Agentic AI acts.

An agent is given a goal, not a question. It plans, uses tools, checks what came back, and keeps going.

Chat: ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude
One turn at a time. You carry every result to the next step.
Agentic: Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex · open source: Qwen Code, OpenCode
One goal. It runs for minutes or hours, carrying its own results. The harness is the loop around the model.

Chat sends the data; an agent can send only the question

Horse, harness, carriage

One harness and carriage for open models, run at Western

What is Faraday?

Sex and gender

A moral word in a question about causes

“virtuous lifestyles”

no “war on cancer” metaphors; corrects itself
